FlamingFist_Dwarf_Caster
Fist Wizard Hartlebury is a dwarven wizard and a member of the Flaming Fist. She can be found in Lower City in Act Three.
“
Don't try and sweet talk me - I've heard it all before. Get in line.
„
— Hartlebury

Involvement

Hartlebury[1] is standing watch on the bridge at the Upper City Gate Checkpoint. She watches over the queue of residents trying to make their way into the Upper City.

Having received orders to not let anyone into the Upper City, Hartlebury and her fellows:  Fist Grassley,  Fist Magnolia,  Fist Nudelmann and  Fist Qirahe, accompanied by a  Steel Watcher, are trying to keep the queue orderly and prevent anyone from entering. If spoken to, Hartlebury, just as most other guards in the cordon, takes the player character for a citizen who tries to make their way through the gate ahead of the queue.

If the party return to the city after acquiring all Netherstones, three infected refugees near the queue transform into  Mind Flayers and attack the bypassers. Hartlebury is  Surprised, but fights alongside the party. Once the Mind Flayers are dead, she and all the Fists around run away to warn their superiors, before completely vanishing from the game once far enough.
